description: Source document and OCR/extraction quality metrics aligned with OAS IdsDocumentQualityMetrics.

pageCount.description: Total number of pages in the document

pagesEvaluated.description: Number of pages evaluated for quality metrics

ocrQuality.description: Optical Character Recognition quality score (0.0 = illegible, 1.0 = perfect)

agbExtraction.description: Indicates whether the document is an AGB (Allgemeine Geschäftsbedingungen) which may require special handling.

agbPagesRemoved.description: List of page numbers removed from the document due to AGB extraction.

postprocessingInformation.description: Information about post-processing steps applied to the document after initial extraction, which may impact quality assessment.

completenessScore.description: Percentage of expected/required fields successfully extracted (0.0-1.0)

sourceDocumentHash.description: SHA-256 cryptographic hash of original source document
